File Information
Collection: Delta Pharmacy API - QA Regression + Security Probes
Environment: Delta Pharmacy - Local
Collection Description
Runnable Postman collection generated from source-code analysis of the Delta Pharmacy fullstack project. Run the 'Setup' folder first (top to bottom), then the rest in order. Each 'ALL Bad Scenarios' request fires several sub-requests via pm.sendRequest and asserts on each independently - open the Test Results panel after running it to see every sub-test. Requests prefixed [SECURITY]/[CRITICAL SECURITY]/[IDOR FINDING CHECK] assert the SAFE/expected outcome; a failing test on one of these means the corresponding vulnerability is confirmed exploitable against your running backend - treat a failure there as a P1 bug, not a broken test. Before running: import the accompanying environment file and set 'baseUrl' if your backend runs on a different host/port than http://localhost:8545/pharmacy-api/api (see application.properties).
